title: Causal Explanations and XAI
reasoning: The paper focuses on the formal and mathematical definitions of causal and counterfactual explanations in the field of Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI). While it includes a section on actual causation and fairness and uses a brief hypothetical example involving religiosity to illustrate its causal framework, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as core components of its research.
